note: House pins: single films the rules place wrong, fixed for everyone on this installation. A pattern of three or more films going wrong for one reason is a rule to fix, not a pin to add. Each pin is also a fixture in data/answer_key.json, so the checker guards it. A flavour pin puts a film in one flavour of a tree (member true) or takes it out (member false); a film pinned into a flavour stays in answers that leave another flavour out, so a funny film pinned into monsters is offered under the scary answers too. A specials pin counts a film as a standup special, which only comedy's stand-up answer offers. Personal corrections (per profile) layer on top of these.
